player_declarations: Shunshin 20m to get behind seal-woman near wet mill bridge

sequence.event: Kunoichi with two seal plates anticipates rear approach and throws both onto wet bridge to create rear sealing-wire arc. Shiki physically crosses 20m with Shunshin, reaches her behind before seal fully activates; wire brushes clothing and throws off footing slightly, but no injury.

Shiki's controlled contact with right arm disrupts motor nerves controlling right hand; concealed blade falls. Second precise contact weakens left foot motor function. Woman loses balance, falls prone and is held by Shiki physically, arms pinned behind back; conscious, breathing, left hand and right leg not fully paralyzed. No guaranteed permanence; bridge seal plates discharged and net fades. Result of user's immobilize action only.

Shiki says 'Потому что вам придётся говорить.' Woman fears Shiki's unnervingly subdued manner and uncertain fate, stops struggling, says 'Ты не понимаешь… Если нас возьмут живыми, это ничего не изменит. Ты думаешь, мы единственные, кого отправили?' Her claim unverified; neither number nor factions independently known.

Injured Doton attacker ~30m from bridge at damaged rear platform sees woman caught and med convoy leaving, chooses escape. He channels earth release one-handed into a narrow flooded culvert under damaged mill, starts descending under floor, not yet gone at scene cut. Local Kusa escort shouts warning; pursuit through collapsing beams dangerous.

Kazama Ritsu independently orders Kusa medical rescue team to retreat east behind earth bank with weakly breathing patient still oxygenated and unnamed IV running. Tiyo remains guarded, patient not reached hospital, no new SpO2 known. Captured female whispers 'Он нас бросил.'
